extDescription.message: Test your site's WebMCP tools with a chat that uses them like an agent (Gemini, Claude, Groq, LM Studio…) plus a debug console.

consoleFooter.message: Read only · does not change the flow

placeholder.message: Type what you want to do on this site…

noToolsTitle.message: This page registered no WebMCP tools

setupText.message: Missing: $1. Choose the name, style and model provider. Your key is stored only in your browser.

hello.message: Hi, I'm $1. I test this site through its WebMCP tools, the way an agent would.

noToolsYet.message: No WebMCP tools detected on this page yet.

exWhatQ.message: What can I do on this site?

exFlowQ.message: Test this site's main flow step by step and tell me what worked and what didn't.

running.message: running… (if the page asks you something, answer it there)

consoleEmpty.message: Every call to the model and to the tools shows up here: what was sent, what came back and how long it took.

missingConfig.message: Not configured yet: $1. Open the settings (⚙).

stoppedSteps.message: I stopped after $1 steps to avoid a loop. Tell me how to continue.

emptyReply.message: The model finished without replying. Try again or check the console (>_).

pageNoResponse.message: The page didn't respond (was it closed, or is it still loading?).

toolTimeout.message: The tool took too long to respond.

noBridge.message: I can't read this page's tools. Reload it (⌘R / Ctrl+R) and try again: if the extension was installed or updated while the page was open, the page needs a reload.

noToolsHead.message: **I found no WebMCP tools on this page**, so I can't act on it.

noToolsNative.message: Chrome has WebMCP enabled, but the page didn't register any tools (or hasn't finished loading).

noToolsScreen.message: If the page registers tools per screen, go to the screen where they exist and write again.

noToolsReload.message: If you installed or updated the extension while the page was open, reload it.

noToolsFlag.message: If the page only registers tools when it detects native WebMCP, enable `chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing`.

noToolsLog.message: The page exposes no WebMCP tools: the model wasn't called.

lmstudioDown.message: I couldn't reach LM Studio at $1. Is the server running with a model loaded?

badKey.message: The key is invalid or lacks permission.

rateLimit.message: Your plan's usage limit was reached.

checkUrlModel.message: Check the URL and the model name.

optTagline.message: Test your site's WebMCP tools end to end.

optStylePh.message: E.g. Friendly and brief. Talks like a helpful car salesperson.

optStyleHelp.message: How it talks and behaves. Added to the model's instructions.

optKeyHelp.message: Stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local), one per provider, and sent only to that provider. Check its data-use terms.

optSitesLead.message: WebMCP Flow only runs on these sites. To add one, open it and click the extension icon → "Enable on this site".

optSavedNoPerm.message: Saved, but without permission for that server: the chat won't be able to connect.

optNoPerm.message: No permission to connect to that server.

optPermNotice.message: When you save, Chrome will ask permission to connect to $1.

helpModelGroq.message: Use a model with tool use, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b.

helpModelOpenrouter.message: provider/model format, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b or anthropic/…

helpUrlLmstudio.message: LM Studio → Developer → Start server. Default http://localhost:1234/v1. If LM Studio runs on this computer, use localhost so Chrome asks for no permission.

helpModelLmstudio.message: Empty = the model loaded in LM Studio.

helpUrlCustom.message: Any OpenAI-compatible server (Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Together, Ollama, vLLM…), ending in /v1.

helpModelCustom.message: Required: the model name on that server.

popEnableHint.message: Chrome will ask permission for this domain only. The page will reload so its tools are detected.

popUnsupported.message: WebMCP Flow only works on http or https pages.

popReload.message: Reload the page to open the chat.

popDenied.message: No permission: WebMCP Flow stays off on this site.
